reviews.text: Update ruined it for me. I've used this all for years, a d its been great. I've purchased almost every deck from their store, and enjoyed the art. Unfortunately, the new redesign is horrendous and unintuitive. It’s annoying when app owners just decide to change layouts without any pulse or feedback from their users asking if a redesign is desired.

Ok, but genuinely don’t get why some things can’t be fixed. The limit on the amount of readings is so outrageous and makes no sense. There are ways the dev could fix this and make it more efficient. There are ways that saved readings could take up barely any space and it wouldn’t matter if we had one or three thousand. And there are definitely ways to make it so at least SOME readings aren’t auto-deleted. For example, I don’t know, the year spread. How does it make sense for there to be the forecast feature with the month card displayed when THAT SPREAD WILL ALWAYS BE DELETED?

The readings like Celtic cross no longer have little foresights on meanings anymore… the weekly pull doesn’t save for the week, so if you do it Sunday and want to see your daily card Tuesday it just has you draw a new one instead of showing the card you pulled for the day, if you want to see what your card did the day is you have to go look in saved, it doesn’t give you meanings on daily cards anymore- just the Ryder Waite summary, the new update is a lot less user friendly… was 5 star app my favorite tarot app now I’m going to find a new one.
